messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a ~3% invoice-preview token spike after the TTL/hedging tweak we rolled last night. Looks like some requests are getting hedged twice when the aggregator sees a late proto-join. anyone seen this in shadow? :thinking:
ajay: saw similar in shadow env at ~02:10 UTC. reproducing locally now — suspect the aggregation window overlap + hedging flag is applied pre-join and post-join. quick diff: hedging applied in route_preproc and again in tally_merge.
devon: ugh. that matches an older bug we thought we fixed. overlapping windows can cause a single logical request to be emitted twice to the token ledger if session_id != join_id.
kevin: can we hotfix aggregator to dedupe on (session_id, request_fingerprint) while we investigate canonical join semantics? rollback TTL tweak is another option but that loses perf win.
li: I can slice affected tenant list quickly. run this query on preview ledger:```sql
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as dup_count
FROM preview_events
WHERE received_at between now() - interval '1 hour' and now()
  AND hedged = true
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY dup_count desc
LIMIT 50;
```
ajay: ran that in shadow — top 10 tenants show small dup_count but it's concentrated on long-session streaming routes. sample looks like: tenant: infra-tools (42 duplicates), tenant: marketer-prod (18).
ops-bot: /alert preview-invoice-dup spike=3pct scope=preview env=shadow count=60
sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for aggregator-v2 with dedupe-by-session patch — ETA 10m. trigger: kevin.
kevin: I'll push the patch with a short canary (5 %) and add a temporary metric: hedged_double_count. if that drops to near zero in canary, we promote.
maria: plan sounds good. devon, can you add a regression unit that asserts dedupe under simulated proto-joins? if we miss that, will come back as invoice noise.
devon: on it. quick pseudo-test I used:```py
# simulate pre-join hedged emission
emit(event(session_id='s1', hedged=True))
# late join causes merged event
merge(join_id='j1', session_ids=['s1'])
# aggregator should only record one token charge
assert ledger.charges_for('j1') == 1
```
ajay: also adding a dashboard card to console: hedged_double_count / hedged_total by route for 1h, 6h, 24h. that'll catch regressions during rollout.
kevin: starting canary now. will post status in 5. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — I'll notify CS for tenants we identified and prepare a short note in invoices channel if promotion happens. keeping this thread as decision record.
kevin: canary shows hedged_double_count -> 0 for canary slice after 3m. promoting to 25% then 100% over 30m.
ops-bot: /alert resolution preview-invoice-dup spike resolved scope=preview env=shadow
maria: closing loop — will add follow-up retro item to verify billing previews across long-session streaming routes in postmortems board. :white_check_mark:
